 In a matchup of top-10 players on Friday, Aryna Sabalenka (No. 2) will face Elina Svitolina (No. 6) in the Round Robin at the Akron WTA Finals Guadalajara.
 Sabalenka is favored over Svitolina, with -200 odds against the underdog’s +154.
 Akron WTA Finals Guadalajara Info 
 Tournament: The Akron WTA Finals Guadalajara
 Round: Round Robin
 Date: Friday, November 13
 Venue: Indian Wells Tennis Garden
 Location: Indian Wells, California
 Court Surface: Hard
